subject: Data Engineering
title: Spark Streaming
description: A short lesson to help you apply Spark Streaming.

hook.text: Spark was built for batch. But real-time use cases kept asking: can Spark handle streams too?

buildup.text: Spark Streaming broke continuous data into micro-batches and processed each with the Spark engine.

discovery.text: Structured Streaming later unified batch and streaming APIs, letting one codebase handle both.

twist.text: Micro-batching adds seconds of latency. For sub-second needs, purpose-built tools like Flink win.

climax.text: Spark Streaming is good enough for 90% of streaming use cases — and that's why it's so popular.

punchline.text: Good enough for most. That's Spark Streaming's superpower.

quiz.question: How does Spark Streaming process continuous data?
options: By processing one event at a time
By storing it all before processing
